svg.title: From a few candidates to a curve
svg.desc: Three panels of the same update under a flat prior with four, twenty, and two hundred candidate rates. The bars narrow into a smooth right-skewed curve peaking near 0.10, and a summary interval is drawn beneath the finest panel.
svg.text: The result stays a distribution however finely you slice the candidates
flat prior, four loose caps in forty bottles
flat prior, four loose caps in forty bottles
flat prior, four loose caps in forty bottles
Give every candidate the same prior weight and let the candidate
list get finer. The picture stops being a row of bars and becomes
a curve, and the curve is the result. A single number and an
interval are summaries you read off it, not replacements for it.
